facts.fact: Vero 描述发作后的夹层：脑静了却关不掉，他不爱这「太多空间」
facts.anchor: My brain has gone quiet but won’t switch off. Brawley calls it the in-between

facts.fact: Vero 直接问棺中感受，此前 Clay 只给哭的许可、无人要她讲述
facts.anchor: What was it like in the coffin?

facts.fact: Kayla 说出棺中荒诞念头：最后一件事竟是纠结要不要给他带糖
facts.anchor: if no one came, the last thing I would have done was get lunch

facts.fact: Aaron 曾「训练」掉她的恐慌发作——不是治好，是让她不敢当着他的面发作
facts.anchor: Aaron had trained me out of them while we were together, which sounds like a good thing, but it wasn’t

facts.fact: 棚屋里 Vero 先问再碰，Kayla 说这是她敢继续的原因
facts.anchor: you asked and didn’t just touch me

facts.fact: Vero 承认：最愤怒的事无法用纸割解决，他的行为抹不掉 Aaron 的
facts.anchor: It turns out what I was most angry about isn’t something you can solve with paper cuts

facts.fact: Vero 担心自己的庆幸显得是坏人，Kayla 答她也感恩人生把她带到这里
facts.anchor: I’m glad your past led you to me

facts.fact: 章末 Kayla 等来的不是焦虑而是和平：永不再回头看，也许她和他们一样疯
facts.anchor: Maybe I am just as crazy as they are
